reviews.review: From what I've played so far, I'm not disappointed at all. It's a great game to play with friends as well.

This is quite the addictive-non-furry-rouge-lit i didn't know i needed in my life.

Best cat-siren-class gameplay since BL2. Uwu.
Give me aim assist god, i suck
